goal: Reduce repeated expression evaluation and value cloning in ORDER BY comparison for full-schema rows.
scope: No semantic changes to alias, ordinal, projection, GROUP BY, or set-operation ordering
implementation: Resolve wildcard SELECT ORDER BY identifiers and ordinals to schema row indices before sorting.
Use direct row-index value references during sort comparison instead of cloning Values.
Keep existing projection and expression sort paths for non-wildcard and computed ORDER BY cases.
